title: Anthropic's $3.4B bet on power: AI is a 5-layer cake

post.caption:
Anthropic just made a $3.4B bet, and it's not on a new AI model.
It's on power: about 1.7 GW of generators, reportedly.
AI is a 5-layer cake, and the bottom layer is energy. Without it, none of it runs.
Follow for AI and tech, made simple.
